verdict.rationale: Algolia's docs say typo tolerance is provided out of the box and can be customized to control how tolerant search is (algolia-docs-7, algolia-docs-45), and that typos are part of its matching (algolia-docs-74). Independent users confirm that typo handling works well in production (algolia-comm-16, algolia-comm-18). Missing for 10: specific tuning controls (e.g., word-length thresholds, per-attribute disabling, or conditions for when fuzzy matching applies) are only asserted generically, not documented in the evidence.
